mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES keeps falling while TRANSIT remains below baseline, fewer commuters will pass through retail corridors and lunch-time shopping trips will weaken, so RETAIL_REC will stay lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean for four consecutive weekly means even though WORKPLACES remains more negative than -15 and TRANSIT remains below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in GROCERY_PHARM above about 20 points signals substitution toward essential trips and away from discretionary shopping, which suppresses RETAIL_REC over the next one to two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall below its last-4-week mean within two weeks after GROCERY_PHARM moves above +20.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES and TRANSIT move together in the same direction, the combined commuter flow through business districts amplifies discretionary stopovers, producing higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its prior 4-week average for the next four weekly means despite simultaneous improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained recovery in PARKS usage draws outdoor leisure trips away from malls and shopping streets, so RETAIL_REC weakens over the next two weeks when PARKS continues to improve from a depressed base.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 5 points from its recent weekly mean while still remaining below baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within two weeks after PARKS increases by at least 5 points from the prior weekly mean while staying negative.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT drops below -10 while WORKPLACES is already weak, the city is likely experiencing tighter movement frictions that cut discretionary visits to retail areas, pulling RETAIL_REC down over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -10 and WORKPLACES stays below -15
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall below its last-4-week mean during the following month after TRANSIT crosses below -10 with WORKPLACES below -15.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in RESIDENTIAL time indicates more stay-at-home behavior, which reduces out-of-home discretionary shopping and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next one week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall in the next weekly mean when RESIDENTIAL is above its recent 4-week average.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both remain elevated, routine essential trips and outdoor leisure absorb time and spending that would otherwise go to shopping centers, so RETAIL_REC is pushed lower over the next two to four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean even though both GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS remain above baseline throughout the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Once TRANSIT recovers to near-normal levels, retail access improves quickly and retail footfall rebounds; therefore RETAIL_REC will rise over the next two weeks only in a reopening regime.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to exceed its last-4-week mean within two weeks after TRANSIT rises above -5.
